title: EviGraph FinQA 600-Example LLM Direct RAG Baseline
limitations: This manifest requires LLM_PROVIDER=openai_compatible plus LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, and LLM_MODEL.
The LLM Direct RAG baseline uses retrieval-order evidence and does not use the EviGraph operation planner, risk-aware support selection, or verifier-guided repair.
The verifier still scores the output after generation so exact match and support diagnostics are comparable to the local baselines.
FinQA-600 should be reported separately from FinQA-300 because it is a larger diagnostic subset sampled with the same seed and a larger pool.
